premise: At sunset Seal waits for her friend the fishing boat; when she sees Gull circling she knows the boat is near, because gulls follow fishing boats home.
inspiration: The waiting-by-the-sea songs of folk tradition, with the worry taken out: the sign is a gull, and the boat always comes home.

en-US.title: The Boat Comes Home
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] The sun was going down, golden and pink. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal sat on the rocks, {seal:face sad} looking out at the water. Her friend was late. [short pause] Then, far away, she saw a white shape flying round and round. {seagull:enter} It was Gull! {seal:face happy} Whenever a boat goes fishing, the gulls follow it home, hoping for a snack. {seal:hop} {seal:face surprised} So if Gull was here… {sfx:chug} Chug, chug, chug. {fishing-boat:enter} Here came the fishing boat, blue and white, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} with Gull flying right behind. {seal:live} Seal clapped her flippers. Arf! {fishing-boat:live hold} The boat hauled up its net, all wet and dripping, and rocked gently. {seagull:go to rocks} Gull came down to rest. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} [softly] The sky turned deep blue. The moon came up. {seagull:face sleeping} Gull tucked her head under her wing. {seal:face sleeping} Seal closed her eyes. [whispers] And the fishing boat, home at last, rocked gently in the dark. {fishing-boat:float 0.3} Swish… swash…

es-ES.title: La barca vuelve a casa
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] El sol se escondía, dorado y rosa. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca estaba en las rocas, {seal:face sad} mirando el agua. Su amiga llegaba tarde. [short pause] Entonces, a lo lejos, vio una figura blanca que volaba en círculos. {seagull:enter} ¡Era Gaviota! {seal:face happy} Cuando un barco sale a pescar, las gaviotas lo siguen hasta casa, por si cae algo de comer. {seal:hop} {seal:face surprised} Así que si Gaviota estaba aquí… {sfx:chug} Chuc, chuc, chuc. {fishing-boat:enter} Ahí llegaba la barca de pesca, azul y blanca, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} con Gaviota volando justo detrás. {seal:live} Foca dio palmadas con las aletas. ¡Arf! {fishing-boat:live hold} La barca subió su red, chorreando, y se meció despacio. {seagull:go to rocks} Gaviota bajó a descansar. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} [softly] El cielo se puso azul oscuro. Salió la luna. {seagull:face sleeping} Gaviota metió la cabeza bajo el ala. {seal:face sleeping} Foca cerró los ojos. [whispers] Y la barca, por fin en casa, se mecía despacito en la oscuridad. {fishing-boat:float 0.3} Chis… chas…
